subject: Aligning demo window and buying-committee intros
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healthgrid.io>, Erin Liu <erin.liu@healthgrid.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-14T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + next meeting windows

Thanks again for the call earlier — great context on where HealthGrid is headed for Q4. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Goal: run a 60-minute technical demo focused on inference latency/cost tradeoffs for your dataset and discuss SSO + audit logging for HIPAA workloads.
- Attendees we recommend: your platform lead, one security contact, and procurement for contracting questions.

Proposed 60-min windows (PT):
- Tue 2028-06-20 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2028-06-21 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 2028-06-22 08:00–09:00 PT

Attachments: SOC2_onepager.pdf (short summary), link to our playbook above.

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side should be on the call so I can loop in the right Redwood folks (I’ll bring Marissa for the demo and Karthik for security questions if needed)?

Thanks,

—
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Samir Patel <samir@healthgrid.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Erin Liu <erin.liu@healthgrid.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-14T18:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next meeting windows

Nikhil — thanks, helpful summary.

Wed 2028-06-21 13:00–14:00 PT works best for our core team. I’ll ask Erin to invite our platform engineer (Maya Chen) and our security manager (Liu Zhang). Procurement will likely need to triage contract-level questions, so I’ve cc’d procure@healthgrid.io (they’ll confirm if they can make the session or want a shorter procurement-only sync after the demo).

One ask: can you include a short agenda in the invite (15 min demo run, 20 min Q/A with security, 10 min contract/next-steps)? That will help us coordinate folks.

Samir
VP, Product — HealthGrid
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healthgrid.io>, Erin Liu <erin.liu@healthgrid.io>, procure@healthgrid.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-14T19:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next meeting windows

Thanks Samir — Wed 2028-06-21 13:00–14:00 PT confirmed on our side. I’m looping in Marissa (demo lead) and Karthik (security) on this thread so they can prep: 

Marissa — can you own the technical demo and keep it tightly focused on latency profiles, quantization options, and expected token cost for a 1M-token monthly baseline?
Karthik — would you prepare a 5–7 minute security slide covering data segmentation, retention, and audit logs, and bring the SOC2 one-pager to the call.

Samir / Erin / Procurement — draft agenda below; I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a short pre-read (SOC2 one-pager + MCA draft) attached.

Agenda (60 min):
- 00–10: Introductions & success criteria
- 10–30: Live demo (Marissa) — typical workload, tradeoffs
- 30–45: Security Q/A (Karthik) — ingestion, storage, audit trail
- 45–55: Procurement/contract questions (open)
- 55–60: Next steps & decision cadence

Attachments I’ll include in the invite: SOC2_onepager.pdf, MCA_draft_v1.docx. Also linking our internal eval checklist for reference: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/HealthGrid/discovery-notes

If procurement prefers a separate call after the demo, that’s fine — we’ll be ready either way.

—
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healthgrid.io>, Erin Liu <erin.liu@healthgrid.io>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, procure@healthgrid.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-15T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next meeting windows

Great — Wed 6/21 13:00 PT is locked on our calendar. I’ll run the demo and keep the first half curated (we’ll use a sanitized sample close to your production profile). Quick notes for attendees: 

Pre-read (attached): SOC2_onepager.pdf, MCA_draft_v1.docx
(Please skim the MCA before the call — there are a few commercial terms we can flag early.)

Proposed deliverables for the meeting:
- A short config recommendation for initial pilot (targeting 99th pct latency under 300ms for chat workloads)
- Security checklist items and actions (Karthik to call out any gaps)
- Procurement owners and timeline to review MCA

Samir/Erin — who will be the single point of contact for follow-ups and contract feedback? If you prefer, procurement can handle redlines directly via the MCA_draft_v1.docx link.

Looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: MCA_draft_v1.docx (editable), SOC2_onepager.pdf (summary)
